I open in R, c in I, f:I->R, L in R
f'(c)=L <=> f(c+h)=f(c)+L*h+o(|h|) as h->0
f'(c) exists => lim_(x->c) f(x)=f(c)
provenance: Original mathematical exposition; equivalence follows directly by subtracting L from the difference quotient.
